q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS TotalSales
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer:
**Top 5 Best‑Selling Genres (by total sales)**  

| Rank | Genre                | Total Sales (USD) |
|------|----------------------|-------------------|
| 1    | Rock                 | $826.65 |
| 2    | Latin                | $382.14 |
| 3    | Metal                | $261.36 |
| 4    | Alternative & Punk  | $241.56 |
| 5    | TV Shows             | $93.53 |

These totals are calculated by summing `UnitPrice × Quantity` for every invoice line that belongs to a track in each genre.

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_004.answer: The most popular media type, based on the number of tracks, is **“MPEG audio file”** with **3,034 tracks**.

q_009.sql:
SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC) AS Rank
FROM (
   SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName,
          SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpending
   FROM Customer c
   JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
   GROUP BY c.CustomerId
) sub
ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer:
**Top 5 customers by total spending**

| Rank | CustomerId | FirstName | LastName | TotalSpending |

q_010.sql:
SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY GenreCount DESC, ArtistName;
q_010.answer:
